ruleDefinitions.name: Sticky Key Like Backdoor Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the usage and installation of a backdoor that uses an option to register a malicious debugger for built-in tools that are accessible in the login screen

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\winlogon\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wt\\\.exe$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*sethc\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*utilman\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*osk\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Magnify\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Narrator\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DisplaySwitch\\\.exe.*")))
